manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Hold the light brown cylindrical roller with both arms.

Task description: The target is the light-brown cylindrical roller lying diagonally toward the front right of the table. Grasp and lift it together with both arms.

Success criteria: Both grippers remain closed and jointly hold the roller. The roller is lifted to a clearly suspended height above the tabletop.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping straight cylindrical sections slightly inward from each roller end, avoiding end-face edges for full pad contact. Leave enough spacing between grippers to prevent interference.
- Open and close approximately perpendicular to the roller's long axis, opening slightly wider than the local diameter. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides to reduce off-center pressure or pushing it to roll.
- When both arms support the load, maintain the distance and relative pose between the grasp points, lifting slowly and in sync to reduce twisting or slipping on one side.
